Oversight board confirms NLSA client money rules

Published 13 November 2026

The Legal Oversight Board has noted the Northbridge Legal Standards Authority's final rules on accountant's reports, which the NLSA Board approved on 11 November 2026.

From 1 March 2027, every NLSA-regulated firm that holds client money must send the NLSA an accountant's report within six months of the end of its accounting period. Firms that held an average of less than 10,000 pounds of client money over the year are exempt. A fixed penalty of 750 pounds applies to late or missing reports.

No further approval is needed.
